paragraphs: After Grandpa’s funeral, I went back to his bedroom to sort through the things he had left behind.
Among his belongings, I found a photograph, yellow with age. Grandpa and his coworkers stood together outside the factory gate.
Looking at it, the stories Grandpa told me when I was little came rushing back, one after another.

I found his old diary too. I had always wanted to visit Mom and Grandpa’s hometown, and this was my chance. With the diary and photograph packed away, I rode my motorcycle to the coal washing plant where he used to work.
The engine is quiet now. Standing outside the factory, I wonder if the gate still looks the way it did in that photograph.
